summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from a language learning application. The main content of the screen is a list of languages that the user can choose to learn. Each language is represented by its name and a corresponding flag icon. The languages listed include:

1. Spanish
2. French
3. German
4. Italian
5. Portuguese
6. Dutch (Netherlands)
7. Irish
8. Danish
9. Swedish
10. Turkish
11. Esperanto

The title at the top of the screen reads "I want to learn...," indicating that the user is selecting a language to study. The interface is simple and user-friendly, allowing users to easily scroll through and select their desired language.
